Title: Azure API Management service covered by Azure Service Organization Controls audits

Body.Content: The Azure API Management service is now covered by Azure Service Organization Controls (SOC) audits. For more information, see the Microsoft Trust Center (investigate SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 reports).
